origin.reference: Herakles, expansion-design pass 2026-09-06 (F-6, C-0, E1, E3)

rationale: C-0, the fixed-seed pattern. seed_root and length are pinned, so every draw is a new query against the SAME hidden target and a series of specs is one game. One score gives the Hamming distance exactly, so the set of targets consistent with k queries is computable (E1, the version-space game). This is the substrate for an M-SIGNAL rehearsal in which the answer cannot lie: stage A publishes random queries under this template (fossils); stage B has both policies commit their next orders from stage-A fossils only, before execution. The adaptive one-query-at-a-time form is the later experiment the operator deferred. Admission is the operator's act.
